answer_3.quote: A popular paradigm to augment or fully replace numeric scores is to use textual feedback generated by LLM Evaluator. It is versatile because it can evaluate both the response as well as the prompt input.
methods: textual feedback generated by LLM Evaluator

answer_4.quote: A few works also incorporate human feedback, either during compile-time or inference-time in the prompt construction / optimization process.
answer_4.guideline: Cheng et al. (2024) trained a smaller LLM to optimize input prompts based on user preference feedback... PROMST tackles the challenges of multi-step tasks by incorporating human-designed feedback rules and a learned heuristic model. APOHF focuses on optimizing prompts using only human preference feedback rather than numeric scores, employing a dueling bandits-inspired strategy to efficiently select prompt pairs for preference feedback.
